UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: Saudi Pro League make their position clear on João Félix crisis: will Al-Nassr get an exception? Goal.com
bullets: A Saudi Pro League spokesperson, Batarji, said the league will not intervene in Al-Nassr's financial commitments or make exceptions to help renew João Félix's contract. Al-Nassr are under active financial supervision, and the league said its criteria apply to all clubs without distinction. Any breach is handled under uniform regulations to ensure fairness between clubs.

The league offered to review Al-Nassr's finances and agree corrective plans, and said the club can review their allocation from the player acquisition programme. It stressed that financial supervision does not hand out money to clubs. Félix joined from Chelsea in the summer of 2025 on a two-year contract. According to Transfermarkt, he has scored 34 goals and provided 30 assists in 63 matches.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
Al-Nassr have put renewing Félix's contract high on their list of priorities, with the player now a key figure in the side. But the club are under active financial supervision, and that raises questions over whether they can meet the commitments needed to get the extension done.

Turki Al-Ajmah raised the issue on the "Al-Manassa" programme on Thmanyah, asking whether the Pro League could step in and help Al-Nassr clear the obstacles to a new deal. Keeping a star of Félix's stature, he argued, isn't just a sporting gain for the team. It also adds marketing value to the Roshn League.

Arthur Rezende reduced the deficit in the 63rd minute before Mekan Saparow headed the fourth six minutes later. Al Rayyan’s influence in the game grew, with Mitrovic firing wide from just above the area after being teed up by Gabriel Pereira in the 20th minute. bullets: Al Wahda came from behind to beat Kuwait SC 2-1 in Group A of the AFC Champions League Two, moving to an unassailable 12 points, five ahead of second-placed PFC Nasaf of Uzbekistan. Al Wahda failed to land a shot on target in the first half, and captain Omar Khrbin was booked within the first minute. The UAE outfit, however, put the minor setback behind them and edged possession.

Adam Gnezda Cerin and Sam Mark both missed chances within the opening 15 minutes, but the first noteworthy attempt dropped at the other end in the 22nd minute courtesy of Barrahma, who saw his 18-yard strike well handled by keeper Facundo Lirussi.

Joao Felix eventually scored the winner after Ronaldo’s penalty had been cancelled out by Mohammed Waad, who was subsequently sent off, handing Nassr a numerical advantage that they used to move up to nine points and fifth place in the league standings.

The win saw Nassr bounce back from their Saudi Pro League defeat to rivals Al Ahli, but manager Ange Postecoglou cut a frustrated figure throughout. Asked why he looked so moody, the Australian said: “I am happy. I did not smile because I feel a little tired and have a lot of problems to think about.

bullets: Al Ittihad of Saudi Arabia beat Pakhtakor of Uzbekistan 2-0 at home on matchday five of the AFC Champions League Elite. Muhannad Al Shanqiti gave the hosts the lead in the seventh minute, and George Ilenikhena made the points safe with a close-range finish two minutes into the second half.

The win takes Jens Wissing's side to seven points from five matches, while Emilian Caras's Pakhtakor remain without a win in the campaign, on two points. Al Shanqiti scored with a first-time strike after Houssem Aouar's cross and a Marwan Al Sahafi backheel, and Aouar hit the crossbar in the 15th minute. Pakhtakor goalkeeper Vladimir Nazarov made several saves, and Al Ittihad goalkeeper Predrag Rajkovic denied Oybek Bozorov before the interval.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo’s Saudi Pro League could look completely different next season as radical rule change eme... World Soccer Talk
bullets: The Saudi Arabian Football Federation is reportedly considering loosening foreign-player limits for the Saudi Pro League from the 2027-28 season, according to Asharq Al-Awsat, citing private sources. Proposals include raising the allowance to 14, 16 or 18 players per club, or removing the limit altogether, with strict financial and regulatory controls. No final decision has been announced.

Under the current 2026-27 rules, each club can register 10 foreign players in a 25-man first-team squad, and up to eight can be included on league matchdays. The federation reportedly wants to encourage Saudi players to move abroad or to smaller-budget clubs, and has sent clubs a questionnaire on player development. Cristiano Ronaldo's Al-Nassr contract expires on 30 June 2027.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
Cristiano Ronaldo‘s future at Al-Nassr remains a major talking point as Saudi soccer continues to explore ways of strengthening its domestic competition. A potential change to the league’s regulations could have a significant impact on how clubs recruit, build their squads, and compete for silverware from next season.

The discussions come as the Saudi Pro League continues its push to attract international talent while improving opportunities for homegrown players. However, the proposals could also raise important questions about the balance between foreign recruitment and the development of Saudi soccer.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: MD5: PFC Neftchi (UZB) 2-2 Al Hilal SFC (KSA) The AFC
bullets: PFC Neftchi of Uzbekistan drew 2-2 with Saudi Arabia's Al Hilal at Istiqlol Stadium on matchday five of the AFC Champions League Elite. Al Hilal led 2-0 after 28 minutes. Ollie Watkins scored in the 21st minute, and Gabriel Martinelli curled in a second after a Watkins flick-on.

Neftchi pulled a goal back within five minutes of the restart through Abrorbek Ismoilov. They levelled in the 70th minute when a Yassine Bounou save struck Al Hilal's Yusuf Akcicek and went into the net. An Alisher Odilov header was ruled out for offside in the 57th minute. A late block by Kalidou Koulibaly on Koffi Kouau in the box stopped Neftchi completing the comeback, and the sides shared the points.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
An action-packed match saw the Saudi Arabian side race to a 2-0 lead after 28 minutes but Uzbekistan’s Neftchi roared in the second half to earn a deserved point. Both teams started aggressively, serving up plenty of entertainment for the crowd at Istiqlol Stadium.

Yusuf Akcicek pumped a long pass in the sixth minute for Gabriel Martinelli, whose first touch was sublime but effort wasn’t as Botirali Ergashev smothered the ball. The breakthrough came in the 21st minute for the visitors as Ollie Watkins intercepted Ibrokhimkhalil Yuldoshev’s underhit backpass, then nipped ahead of Ergashev to slot home from an acute angle.

bullets: Saudi Arabia will host the AFC Champions League Elite knockout stages from 23 April to 1 May 2027, with the host city yet to be announced. Saudi newspaper Asharq Al-Awsat reports that Dammam and Khobar have moved ahead in the race, with three proposed venues: Aramco Stadium, the Al-Ettifaq Club stadium and the Prince Mohamed bin Fahd Stadium.

The Saudi Arabian Football Federation and the Asian Football Confederation are awaiting a Ministry of Sport report on facility readiness, including the requirement for eight training pitches. Scheduling with the Saudi Pro League must also be resolved. The Eastern Province's 70% likelihood is not an official decision, and Jeddah remains the second option.

Saudi Arabia will host the tournament's knockout stages from 23 April to 1 May 2027. Organisers are working intensively to complete the organisational and technical arrangements and make sure the facilities that will house the participating teams are ready before they officially announce the host city.

According to Saudi newspaper Asharq Al-Awsat, Dammam and Khobar have surged to the front of the race to host the Asian tournament. Their trump card is three main stadiums, which strengthen the Eastern Province's capacity to stage the event.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: Al Jazira return to top with dramatic draw vs Khorfakkan, Shabab Al Ahli beat Ajman Gulf Today
bullets: Al Jazira returned to the top of the 2026-27 ADNOC Pro League after Vinicius Mello scored in the sixth minute of stoppage time for a 1-1 draw at Khorfakkan in Matchweek 9. Haliru Sarki had put Khorfakkan ahead in the 65th minute. Al Jazira are on 18 points, level with Sharjah, and extended their unbeaten league run, while Khorfakkan are ninth on eight points.

Shabab Al Ahli beat Ajman 3-1 to move fourth on 16 points, with goals from Yuri Cesar, Guilherme Da Silva and Jahnoah Guevara Markelo. Lithierry Silva scored Ajman's goal in the 72nd minute, and they stayed eighth on 10 points. Bani Yas won their first league match of the season, beating Al Nasr 2-1 from behind through Youssoufou Niakate and Alhassan Koroma, to move to five points in 13th.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
Players of Al Jazira and Khorfakkan in action during their Pro League match on Saturday. Al Jazira returned to the top of the 2026–27 Adnoc Pro League standings after Vinicius Mello scored a dramatic stoppage-time equaliser to secure a 1-1 draw against Khorfakkan at Saqr Bin Mohammad Al Qassimi Stadium on Saturday in Matchweek 9.

Haliru Sarki put Khorfakkan ahead in the 65th minute, but Mello rescued a point for the visitors with a powerful strike from outside the penalty area in the sixth minute of added time.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.title: بني ياس يقلب تأخره إلى انتصار 2-1 على النصر في الجولة التاسعة من دوري أدنوك للمحترفين
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: بني ياس يقلب تأخره إلى انتصار 2-1 على النصر في الجولة التاسعة من دوري أدنوك للمحترفين https://emirates24.net/
bullets: Bani Yas came from behind to beat Al Nasr 2-1 at Bani Yas Stadium in round nine of the ADNOC Pro League. It was their first win of the season and lifted them to 13th with five points. Al Nasr stayed seventh on 11 points. Ramon Mierez had put Al Nasr ahead in first-half stoppage time with a header after Kevin Ardila's shot rebounded off the post.

Al Nasr dominated the first half and missed several chances, while Bani Yas relied on rare counter-attacks. Bani Yas goalkeeper Fahad Al Dhanhani saved a close-range effort early in the second half. Bani Yas equalised in the 64th minute on a counter-attack, and Al Hassan Koroma scored the winner with a low shot in the 70th minute. Al Nasr pushed for an equaliser but the defence held.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
على ملعب استاد بني ياس، استضاف الفريق السماوي نظيره النصر في إطار الجولة التاسعة من دوري أدنوك للمحترفين، وانتهت المباراة بفوز صاحب الأرض بهدفين مقابل هدف، ليحقق بني ياس أول انتصار له في المسابقة هذا الموسم ويرفع رصيده إلى خمس نقاط متقدماً إلى المركز الثالث عشر، بينما ظل رصيد النصر ثابتاً عند إحدى عشرة نقطة في المركز السابع.

افتتح النصر التسجيل في الدقيقة الأولى من الوقت المحتسب بدل الضائع من الشوط الأول، حيث سجل رامون ميريز هدفاً برأسية تابع بها كرة ارتدت من القائم إثر تسديدة قوية من كيفين أرديلا، وسيطر العميد النصراوي على مجريات اللعب في هذا الشوط، مقدماً أداءً هجومياً أفضل وأهدر عدة فرص محققة، في حين اعتمد بني ياس على هجمات مرتدة نادرة افتقرت إلى اللمسة الأخيرة، وكاد النصر أن يضيف هدفاً ثانياً قبل صافرة نهاية الشوط.

bullets: Cristiano Ronaldo missed a penalty for Al Nassr as Al Ahli won 3-1 in Jeddah on Friday, in a Saudi Pro League fixture postponed from the ninth round. Ronaldo opened the scoring in the 14th minute, in his first game since retiring from the Portugal national team. His penalty then struck the post, his second consecutive league penalty miss. Galeno equalised at the end of the first half, Ivan Toney scored a penalty in the 71st minute after a VAR review, and Roger Ibanez headed in a third in the 75th.

Toney leads the Saudi Pro League scoring chart with 14 goals, ahead of Ronaldo on nine. Tijjani Reijnders of Al Qadsiah is third on eight, with Alexandre Lacazette, Mateo Retegui and Youssef En-Nesyri on seven. Al Nassr have 22 league matches left. They play Al Sadd in the AFC Champions League Elite on 24 November, then host Al Hazem in the league on 28 November.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
Cristiano Ronaldo had the chance to take another step toward Ivan Toney in the Saudi Pro League scoring race on Friday, but a missed penalty left the gap exactly where it was.

The Portuguese forward scored for Al Nassr in Jeddah, yet Al Ahli came back to win 3-1, with Toney converting a penalty of his own to put the hosts ahead. The result keeps Ronaldo second in the scoring chart, behind the English striker who leads it.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.title: Cristiano Ronaldo scores but close to tears after penalty miss as Al Nassr lose 3-1
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo scores but close to tears after penalty miss as Al Nassr lose 3-1 Gulf News
bullets: Cristiano Ronaldo scored his 986th career goal in the 14th minute but missed a penalty minutes later as Al Nassr lost 3-1 to Al Ahli in the Saudi Pro League on Friday. His penalty hit the post, the first time he has missed two consecutive league penalties since joining Al Nassr in January 2023. It was his first appearance since announcing his retirement from international football earlier this month.

Galeno equalised with a strike from outside the box in first-half stoppage time, Ivan Toney put Al Ahli ahead from the penalty spot, and Roger Ibanez headed in from a corner. Al Nassr are third with 28 points, two behind leaders Al Hilal, while Al Ahli are fourth with 24. Al Nassr face Al Hazem on 28 November.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
Cristiano Ronaldo experienced a night of mixed emotions as Al Nassr suffered a 3-1 defeat against Al Ahli in the Saudi Pro League on Friday. The 41-year-old scored his 986th career goal to give Al Nassr an early lead but missed a penalty just four minutes later, setting an unwanted record in the process.

Ronaldo opened the scoring in the 14th minute after Al Ahli made a mistake while trying to play out from the back. Samu Costa won possession and found the Portuguese superstar, who calmly finished into the corner.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.title: SPL highlights spending limits and player recruitment processes at media workshop
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: SPL highlights spending limits and player recruitment processes at media workshop spl.com.sa
bullets: The Saudi Pro League set out its financial regulations and player recruitment processes at a media workshop on Thursday, organised by its Club Affairs department. First-team spending for Roshn Saudi League clubs is capped at 75 per cent of revenue for the 2026-27 season, falling to 70 per cent in 2027-28. Clubs undergo scheduled financial assessments twice a year.

The league also explained a six-stage process for foreign-player signings, supported by its Player Acquisition Centre of Excellence (PACE) programme: identifying needs, initial requests, technical and financial evaluations, negotiations, final approval and registration. Clubs still select players and negotiate within approved budgets, with potential signings assessed using performance data, market valuations and comparable transfers. The session was attended by Jesus Arroyo, Mohammed Al Johani and Abdullah Kaboha.
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
The Saudi Pro League (SPL) outlined its financial regulations and player recruitment processes at a media workshop on Thursday, highlighting measures to promote responsible spending and strengthen the long-term financial sustainability of clubs.

Organised by the SPL's Club Affairs department, the workshop covered spending limits, financial oversight and foreign-player recruitment procedures. The session was attended by Jesus Arroyo, Chief Club Management Officer, Mohammed Al Johani, Deputy Chief Club Management Officer, and Abdullah Kaboha, Chairman of the Financial Control Committee.

bullets: United and Sharjah drew 1-1 at Al Maktoum Stadium in Matchweek 4 of the ADIB Cup. Dieu Mercy put United ahead in the 39th minute, and Clinton Nsiala equalised for Sharjah in injury time, after United goalkeeper Stojan Lukovic had saved Igor Coronado's penalty. United are 10th on four points and Sharjah eighth on five.

Al Jazira climbed to second with 10 points after a 1-0 home win over Bani Yas, who stay fifth on six points. Vinicius Mello headed the winner in the 54th minute, after an earlier goal was ruled out for offside by VAR. Players of United and Sharjah in action during their ADIB Cup match. United and Sharjah played out a 1-1 draw at Al Maktoum Stadium on Sunday in Matchweek 4 of the ADIB Cup. Both goals came in the first half, with Dieu Mercy putting United ahead in the 39th minute before Clinton Nsiala struck an injury-time equaliser for Sharjah in the 45th minute.

The result takes United to four points in 10th place, while Sharjah move to five points in eighth. The closing stages of the first half delivered plenty of drama. United broke the deadlock in the 39th minute when Dieu Mercy fired home with a powerful strike.

Running & Endurance.summary: Abu Dhabi sets 2027 sports and preventative health priorities at Sport Industry Forum Big News Network.com
bullets: Abu Dhabi will put community participation, active lifestyles and preventive health at the centre of its sports agenda in 2027. The priorities were set out as the Sport Industry Forum opened on 24 November at the W Abu Dhabi – Yas Island. More than 300 senior leaders from sport, health and government are attending the forum, which concludes on 25 November.

Abu Dhabi Sports Council said the emirate kept people playing sport through 2026 and pointed to the Mubadala Abu Dhabi SailGP Grand Final, the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix and the ADNOC Abu Dhabi Marathon as the year's closing events. Dr Rashed Al Suwaidi of Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre said cross-sector collaboration can make physical activity part of daily life and help prevent chronic disease. The forum is supported by Abu Dhabi Sports Council, the Abu Dhabi Conventions and Exhibitions Bureau and the Department of Community Development.
Running & Endurance.copy:
ABU DHABI, 24th November, 2026 (WAM) -- Abu Dhabi will put community participation, active lifestyles and preventive health at the centre of its sports agenda in 2027. The priorities were set out as the Sport Industry Forum opened Tuesday at the W Abu Dhabi - Yas Island, with more than 300 senior leaders working in sport, health and government attending.

"We are proud that Abu Dhabi kept people playing sport through a demanding year, with our sports calendar and community programmes continuing throughout 2026. At Abu Dhabi Sports Council we are looking forward to a strong end to the year which includes this weekend's Mubadala Abu Dhabi SailGP Grand Final, Abu Dhabi Grand Prix and ADNOC Abu Dhabi Marathon. In 2027 we go further - more community sport, for every age, with all segments of society adopting healthier and more active lifestyles. The partners in this room can help us deliver it."

Running & Endurance.title: Dubai Marathon 2027: Date, Registration and Route
Running & Endurance.summary: Dubai Marathon 2027: Date, Registration and Route Pixidia
bullets: The 26th Dubai Marathon is scheduled for Sunday 17 January 2027, with the elite start at 5:45 am and the mass start at 6:30 am. Registration is online only at dubaimarathon.org, priced at $150 for the marathon. The 2027 route has not yet been published.

Three races share the day: the marathon, a 10 km road race and a 4 km fun run, with fees for the shorter races still to be confirmed. The 25th edition took place on 1 February 2026 and finished inside the Dubai Police Academy grounds, though the 2027 finish location is unconfirmed. Guides describe the course as following the Jumeirah coast with out-and-back stretches, and the organiser has not confirmed the registration closing date.
Running & Endurance.copy:
The 2027 Dubai Marathon takes place on Sunday 17 January 2027, with the mass start at 6:30 am and the elite start at 5:45 am. According to the organiser, registration is online only at dubaimarathon.org, at $150 for the marathon. The 2027 route has not been published yet.

Checked on against the official sources cited (dubaimarathon.org, gov.uk). The Dubai Marathon runs every winter, in January or early February: the 25th edition took place on Sunday 1 February 2026, and the 26th is announced for Sunday 17 January 2027. Three races share the same day: the marathon (42.195 km), a 10 km road race and a 4 km “fun run”. This article separates what the organiser confirms, what isn’t confirmed yet, and what to plan for whether you’re coming to run or to watch.
